parameter.name: disclaimer
parameter.valueString: Synthetic example, generated for the event's scenarios - it does not come from any real system, record or person, and only illustrates how such a summary could look.

part.name: tagline
part.valueString: Type 1 diabetes, seen in a Paris emergency department

part.name: scenario
part.valueString: A Swedish exchange student is brought into a Paris emergency department with runaway blood sugar. Her summary is complete and well coded, but the data behind it has gone stale: the last labs are eight months old and the follow-up that would have refreshed them was cancelled and never rebooked.

part.name: horizon
part.valueString: Future scenario: under the EHDS Regulation, cross-border exchange of patient summaries is required from around 2029.

part.name: tagline
part.valueString: Multimorbid, admitted after a fall in Copenhagen

part.name: scenario
part.valueString: A Swedish pensioner falls while visiting his son in Denmark and needs surgery. Ten conditions, ten medicines including the anticoagulant apixaban, and a high-criticality penicillin allergy with anaphylaxis have to survive the border.

part.name: horizon
part.valueString: Future scenario: under the EHDS Regulation, cross-border exchange of patient summaries is required from around 2029, and of lab results and discharge reports only from around 2031.

part.name: tagline
part.valueString: Difficult airway and immunosuppressed, in a Gothenburg emergency department

part.name: scenario
part.valueString: A Stockholm boy with a rare craniofacial syndrome, a known difficult airway and juvenile spondyloarthritis on adalimumab and methotrexate arrives at Sahlgrenska with a chest infection and worsening breathing. The team that has never met him needs the airway plan, the last anaesthetic, the last doses and who to ring at Karolinska - before anyone reaches for a laryngoscope.
